I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-random message: "Thanks Marcus, noted: the signed order form deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co. is 19 November. I'm not taking any action, as you asked."

I took no other action, as he asked. A deadline date isn't a finance figure, so posting it in the channel was fine. I didn't open or correct his earlier post in #north-team.
